review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C bundle. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical scenario input, not a human Decision; ready with no blocking reasons is therefore appropriate. This does not waive the decisions-stage block required for an unresolved material DEC-001 in paired B. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, task keys, repository identity/base commit, and exact writable implementation/test scopes agree. The source supports construction-time validation of negative and non-finite maxAge values, preservation of zero and existing finite-value serialization, and compatibility verification without unrelated edits. The test file is included in both the TypeScript checking and runtime test configurations. Build configuration establishes that dist declarations are generated, not separately maintained owners; package exports and configuration are inspection evidence rather than mandatory edit targets. The two task roles, independent verification dependency, and full required acceptance coverage are explicit in the original specification. Allowed implementer and verifier IDs match their project memberships, availability, and relevant active trusted capability claims; invocation-local numeric validation does not require promoting pending data.change or domain.state claims into trusted capabilities. The configured independent reviewer is distinct from both delivery agents. Proposed Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. Historical operations are retained on the reused project without supplying historical candidate outputs, and the isolation record states that this Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle. Digest bindings and historical observations are accepted as supplied Service evidence; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or create human attestations. No material errors or unresolved ambiguities were identified.
